name: W. R. BERKLEY CORP

overrides_applied.source: Anchor: last engine-filed capex $60,457,000 in FY2019 (10-K, PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, financials_history.csv); the filer's own cash-flow statements now report the same line as net purchases of property, furniture and equipment — $53,737,000 for the nine months ended 2025-09-30 and $91,670,000 for the nine months ended 2024-09-30 (10-Q consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities) — confirming the same order of magnitude under a tag the engine does not read.
overrides_applied.reason: Capex tag missing for FY2023-2025 (and all post-2019 periods) because WRB reports capex as net purchases of property, furniture and equipment. $90M is 1.49x the last filed FY2019 value (inside the 0.1x-10x band) and in line with the 9M filed net-purchase figures; it is ~2.5% of FY2025 OCF, so the choice is immaterial to the verdict.

fragility_flags: STALE_FY: latest fiscal year ended 9 months ago — check TTM/quarterly OE and consider --base-oe-ps override
DILUTION: share count growing 883.9%/yr — already deducted via the growth adjustment; check SBC trend
OE_VOLATILE: OE/share range over the last 5 yrs spans >3x — normalized base helps but the business is cyclical; widen bear weight
NI_OCF_DIVERGENCE: net income and operating cash flow differ by >40% in 2023, 2024, 2025 — find the one-off (tax deposits, impairments, WC swings) before trusting the OE base
SECTOR_MODEL_MISMATCH: Finance sector — OE/capex DCF fits finance names poorly; grade confidence low

OVERRIDE_APPLIED:capex — filing gap in the last 3 FY filled by a judgment override (estimate: Anchor: last engine-filed capex $60,457,000 in FY2019 (10-K, PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment, financials_history.csv); the filer's own cash-flow statements now report the same line as net purchases of property, furniture and equipment — $53,737,000 for the nine months ended 2025-09-30 and $91,670,000 for the nine months ended 2024-09-30 (10-Q consolidated statements of cash flows, investing activities) — confirming the same order of magnitude under a tag the engine does not read.); an override never replaces a filed value — see overrides_applied and override_impact
WIDE_SCENARIO_SPREAD: super-bull IV is 4.8x super-bear IV — uncertainty is huge; confidence should not be high

override_impact.basis: engine-native normalized base (median of last 3 FY) and weighted IRR, DCF run both ways (zero-fill baseline vs with-override); a --base-oe-ps TTM base is excluded from both sides — its override effect shows in ttm.py output
